item: Row 288 batch 5: 96 more test files open their SQLite engines with the app's pragmas
summary: 141 bare create_engine calls in 96 test files (none touched by an open PR) now go through tests/_app_engine.py::app_sqlite_engine, so they run with the app's foreign keys, WAL, busy timeout and cache settings; the converted files and every test file importing one of them pass (1934). The ratchet ceiling goes from 356 to 215 calls in 161 files. Test-only, no release line.
